notes.title: 🎉《Dungeon Killing》LAUNCH TODAY! A Solo Dev's Blood, Sweat & Layoff Story
notes.notes:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]After [b]Countless[/b] sleepless nights (and enough coffee to kill a horse), my [b]solo-developed[/b] game 《Dungeon Killing》is now officially live on Steam![/p][p]This is:
⚔️ A [b]match-3 roguelike[/b] forged from unemployment panic
🔮 A [b]tactical dungeon crawler[/b] fueled by severance pay
💀 [b]Iterate through N versions of a strategy game day and night[/b][/p][p][b]Why you'll love it[/b]:
✔ 8 fallen paladins battling personalized Nemeses
✔ 30+ relics enabling game-breaking builds
✔ Adaptive AI bosses that STUDY your tactics[/p][p][/p][p]P.S. [b]Wishlists & reviews[/b] are oxygen to indie devs like me.[/p]
